bullets.text: Microsoft Flight Simulator Update - Aerial firefighting missions introduced in collaboration with **New South Wales Rural Fire Service**.
Azure Expands in Europe - **Microsoft Azure** invests in scalable infrastructure to meet rising cloud and AI demand across Europe.
Free Microsoft Store Registration - Companies can now publish to the **Microsoft Store** with free registration and faster onboarding.
AI Vulnerabilities Identified - **Microsoft** reveals critical vulnerabilities in AI agent frameworks, emphasizing security risks.
Advancing Passwordless Authentication - **Microsoft** pushes for passkey adoption to enhance security and reduce reliance on passwords.
Microsoft's AI SOC Leadership - **Microsoft** recognized as a leader in AI Security Operations Center by KuppingerCole Analysts.
New Builds for Windows Insiders - **Microsoft** announces new builds and ISO support for Windows Insider Program.
Microsoft Agent 365 Launch - **Microsoft** introduces Agent 365 for enhanced governance and security of AI agents.
